claim: 唯物主义是形而上学论题（一切归根到底满足物理条件），SEP将其与泰勒斯'万物皆水'并列，且不否认看似非物质对象的存在。
locator: SEP Physicalism 导言段（'Physicalism is, in slogan form, the thesis that everything is physical...'）
note: 原文把该论题与'万物皆水'及贝克莱观念论并列；明确说physicalist不否认表面非物质的biological/psychological/moral/social/mathematical对象，只坚持它们最终是物理的或与物理者处于重要关系。

claim: 术语史：materialism于17世纪末进入英语；physicalism由纽拉特(1931)与卡尔纳普(1932/1959)于1930年代引入，原初是语言论题（每一陈述与某物理陈述同义，如Hempel 1949所转述）；实证主义拒斥形而上学故两词分立，当代常互换。
locator: SEP Physicalism §1.1 Terminology
note: 原文：'The word materialism appears in English towards the end of the 17th century, but the word physicalism was introduced into philosophy only in the 1930s by Otto Neurath (1931) and Rudolf Carnap (1959/1932), both of whom were key members of the Vienna Circle'；语言论题被表述为'every statement is synonymous with ... some physical statement'。

claim: 区分两词的另一理由：物理学表明引力等是物理的但未必是传统'物质'（贝克莱Principles par.9对物质的刻画'惰性的、无感觉的实体'）；Smart(1963)等当代物理主义者仍自用materialism一词。
locator: SEP Physicalism §1.1 Terminology（第二段；引 Berkeley, Principles of Human Knowledge, par. 9；文献 Langes 1865/Dijksterhuis 1961/Yolton 1983；Smart 1963）
note: 贝克莱引文与Smart用法均见于该节原文。

claim: 古代谱系：德谟克利特'一切皆原子与虚空'；该立场在牛顿前由霍布斯与伽桑狄复兴；18世纪拉美特利与霍尔巴赫自认唯物主义者（人是复杂机器）；马克思博士论文比较德谟克利特与伊壁鸠鲁；20世纪斯马特与刘易斯自认思想先辈；SEP警告勿把不同时代立场归并（牛顿的'力'已不同于原子与虚空）。
locator: SEP Physicalism §1.2 Historical Issues
note: 原文含Lange《唯物主义史》首句引文'(1925, 3)'、'said or allegedly said'标注、Marx博士论文句、'we should be careful in lumping different people in different epochs together'。

claim: 20世纪表述谱系：随附性/同一（token/type）/实现/奠基/根本性；还原与非还原（四种还原义：概念分析、桥律、类型同一、先天衍推）；先天与后验物理主义（克里普克《命名与必然性》1980之后）。
locator: SEP Physicalism §2（The Completeness Question）、§3.1、§3.2
note: §2.2区分token与type physicalism；§3.1列Nagel 1961桥律、Fodor 1974多重实现、Smart 1959 topic-neutral；§3.2论necessary a posteriori与Loar 1997、Jackson 1998。

claim: 反方论证谱系：知识论证（黑白房间中的玛丽）、意义与意向性、第一人称、社会世界、数与抽象对象；亨佩尔困境（当下物理则假、未来物理则空）。
locator: SEP Physicalism §4.3 Hempel's dilemma；§5.1 Qualia and Consciousness（knowledge argument与Mary设定）；§5目录（Meaning and Intentionality / The First Person / The Social World / Numbers and Abstracta）
note: §5.1给出Mary论证的P1/P2两前提；§4.3给出亨佩尔困境的双角表述。

claim: 约公元前5世纪中叶：留基伯与德谟克利特创立原子论——不可分物体在无限虚空运动；古代不依赖目的因的唯物主义说明中最有影响者；留基伯生平几乎无载。
locator: SEP Democritus 导言与§1；SEP Ancient Atomism §2.1 Leucippus and Democritus
note: Democritus导言：'one of the two founders of ancient atomist theory. He elaborated a system originated by his teacher Leucippus'；'atomism was the most influential' among non-teleological materialist accounts；§1：'of whom little is known'（留基伯）。
uncertainty: 留基伯无独立年代记载；德谟克利特生于约前460年有报道依据（DK 68A1），卒年未定位

claim: 伊壁鸠鲁（前341—前270）约前306年在雅典建立原子论学派；经德谟克利特追随者瑙西法涅斯接触学说；学派较封闭、含女性成员。
locator: SEP Ancient Atomism §2.5 Epicurean Atomism（首段与第二段）
note: 原文：'Epicurus (341–270 BCE) founded an atomist school in Athens about 306 BCE'；'through Democritus' follower Nausiphanes'；'The community included women'。

claim: 伊壁鸠鲁的理论改造：区分物理不可分与概念可分（极限部分）；原子直线下落；偶发的无因偏斜系后世权威来源所记（不见于现存著作），卢克莱修将其与行动与责任问题相连；'一切感觉皆真'。
locator: SEP Ancient Atomism §2.5（Epicurus made significant changes...；although this is not attested in the surviving writings...；He notoriously said that 'all perception is true'）
note: 偏斜句：'authoritative later sources attribute to him the idea...a slight, otherwise uncaused swerve'；'it is also said, by Lucretius, to enter into the account of action and responsibility. Scholars have proposed a number of alternative interpretations'。
uncertainty: 偏斜学说如何运作存在多种学术解释，本包未采纳任一

claim: 卢克莱修（约前90年代—前50年代）《物性论》（De rerum natura）为六卷拉丁教谕诗，伊壁鸠鲁原子论物理学现存最完整来源、'偏斜'唯一伊壁鸠鲁派来源；反目的论反神意；卷4—5批评目的论、卷5宗教起源的人文解释。
locator: SEP Lucretius 导言
note: 原文：'Titus Lucretius Carus (mid-90s to mid-50s BCE) was the author of a Latin, six-book didactic poem on Epicurean physics, the De rerum natura'；'our sole Epicurean source for the doctrine of the atomic swerve'；'a nearly unique survival from antiquity of the anti-teleological and anti-providential materialist outlook'。

claim: 霍布斯《利维坦》1651年出版（后有1668年拉丁版）；霍布斯生卒1588—1679。
locator: SEP Thomas Hobbes 导言（1588–1679）与§1（'Hobbes wrote Leviathan, which was published in 1651'；'a Latin edition of Leviathan'）
note: 1651年出版与拉丁版均见于§1 Life and Works。

claim: 霍布斯主张人（含心灵）完全物质；'无形体实体'类语词为无意义；一切原因皆动力因、运动为自然中一切变化之因。
locator: SEP Thomas Hobbes §3 Materialism（首段；'insignificant speech'段引Leviathan ch.4相关文本；§4 Method 末段'he thinks that all causes are efficient causes and that motion is the cause of all change in the natural world'）

claim: 18世纪：拉美特利与霍尔巴赫等法国哲学家自认唯物主义者，主张每人都是一种复杂的机器。
locator: SEP Physicalism §1.2 Historical Issues（'In the eighteenth century, French philosophers like D'Holbach and La Mettrie thought of themselves as materialists...complicated sort of machine'）

claim: 马克思（1818—1883）在《关于费尔巴哈的提纲》（1845）中批评'迄今为止一切唯物主义'忽略人的能动方面；与恩格斯在《德意志意识形态》中提出'唯物主义方法'：从现实的人的物质生产出发，物质生活制约/决定社会生活，解释方向由物质生产→社会形式→意识形式。
locator: SEP Karl Marx 导言（1818–1883；doctorate in ancient philosophy）与§2.2 Early Formulations、§2.3 1859 Preface
